name: Xixona (Spain)
description: Four red bars on yellow, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Xixona (a crowned shield with fleurs-de-lis, a castle and the letters L and F).
history: Municipal flag of Xixona; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Xixona arms — fleurs-de-lis, castle and letters L F
